_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: notes count
cli_commands.description: Count notes created in a time window (--window WINDOW); the reference measure

cli_commands.name: notes attach
cli_commands.description: Upload an attachment for a note (--file PATH)

cli_commands.name: score get
cli_commands.description: Fast cached status for a scenario: maturity rung as of tree digest, 0-100 composite with breakdown, recommendations with point impact, action plan, per-phase freshness verdicts (--json for machine output)
